detail.composition_rule: This is a separately versioned successor morphism contract. It supplements, but does not edit or supersede, PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001. Any theorem is about the explicitly composed candidate and is not retroactive evidence for either parent.

detail.coarse_carrier: A finite connected oriented bounded-degree relational two-cell complex G=(V,E,P) with disjoint nonempty anchors O and C.
detail.configuration: Omega_(rho,Q) and Omega_(rho',Q) are the finite fixed-Q state spaces obtained from the unchanged PAH-001 functional and the PAH-OMC-001 integer-coordinate completion.
detail.fine_carrier: A finite connected oriented bounded-degree relational two-cell complex G'=(V',E',P') with anchor-preserving cell map p:G'->G and at least one fine-only vertex z in V' whose coordinate is integrated out by p_Omega. No embedding coordinates, metric, or physical volume is introduced.
detail.groups: The finite Z_K gauge groups and anchor-preserving automorphism groups already declared by PAH-001 and PAH-OMC-001; p must be equivariant for a specified subgroup homomorphism.
detail.limits: No cutoff, lattice, volume, phase, aperture, beta, observation-time, continuum, or physical limit is taken in this candidate contract.
detail.measure: Counting measure followed by the exact finite PAH Gibbs weights pi_(rho,Q) and pi_(rho',Q).
detail.regulator: rho and rho' use the PAH-001 tuple rho=(G,O,C,K,M_s,M_psi,R_max,epsilon,a,beta,nu,theta,Q) with the transport table below.

detail.K: K'=K and the gauge map is the declared surjection on vertex labels.
detail.M_s: M_s'=M_s; no half-grid or interpolated aperture values are inserted.
detail.Q: Q'=Q; hidden matter occupation is part of the same fixed-Q sector.
detail.a: a'=a; the refinement label is not identified with a physical length.
detail.beta: beta'=beta>0; no fitted or post-hoc beta rescaling is allowed.
detail.cell_couplings: All scalar couplings and the displayed PAH-001 edge, plaquette, onsite, and aperture terms are inherited without counterterm, zeroing, or scalar repair.
detail.weights: No cell-dependent weight is inserted at this version; introducing one requires PAH-OMC-003 or a later separately hashed successor.

detail.conditional_expectation: (E_kappa g)(x)=sum_y kappa(y|x)g(y) for g on Omega_(rho',Q).
detail.configuration_map: p_Omega:Omega_(rho',Q)->Omega_(rho,Q) forgets fine-only coordinates while preserving retained integer coordinates, carried orientations, anchors, and fixed Q.
detail.fibre_partition: Z_fib(x)=sum_(y:p_Omega(y)=x) exp[-beta F_(rho')(y)] for each coarse x; finite positivity makes Z_fib(x)>0.
detail.hidden_root_rule: Fine roots with p_Omega(r'.y)=p_Omega(y) are retained only in L_(rho'); their action is tested as hidden leakage under E_kappa and is not silently deleted from the fine generator.
detail.normalization_targets: E_kappa 1=1 and E_kappa I_p=id on every finite coarse function.
detail.observable_lift: (I_p f)(y)=f(p_Omega(y)) for y in Omega_(rho',Q). This is the cylinder lift used by the strong mainline test; the R-480/R-481 natural-pullback obstruction therefore remains relevant.
detail.retained_root_transport: For every coarse root r, choose a labelled fine retained-root set R'_r such that p_Omega(r'.y)=r.p_Omega(y) on every admissible pair and inverse labels are preserved.
detail.root_measure: Both sides use the exact PAH-OMC-001 directed-root measures, including invalid, parallel-edge, K=2, and duplicate-channel conventions; no new multiplicity convention is introduced here.
detail.symmetry_target: For every allowed gauge or anchor automorphism pair (h',h) with p_Omega h'=h p_Omega, require kappa(h'y|hx)=kappa(y|x) and E_kappa U_(h')=U_h E_kappa.

detail.conditional_kernel_role: The conditional kernel changes the coarse averaging diagnostic E_kappa but does not change the strong lift I_p. It therefore cannot erase the already known strong natural-pullback defect; projected compatibility is a separate, unproved proposition.
detail.natural_pullback: R-480/R-481 show that the source-minimal free-vertex forgetful lift has a nonzero hidden-fibre aperture-rate defect under positive kappa_s and positive scalar beta/kappa_s transport.
detail.successor_boundary: A cell-weight, counterterm, altered functional, altered move set, or non-identity parameter transport is outside PAH-OMC-002 and requires a later separately versioned successor.

detail: An exact finite audit of conditional-kernel equivariance and projected generator equality for the displayed PAH functional.
A compatible retained-root embedding for an actual subdivision family, not merely one isolated map.
A common invariant cylinder core and a normalized defect norm for every refinement level.
Uniform regulator, volume, shape, source, phase, and exhaustion estimates in the inherited ordered-limit sequence.
An independent formal proof of any accepted projected or strong intertwining identity.

non_claims: This independent lane checks contract structure only; it does not prove conditional or strong intertwining.
No PAH-001 or PAH-OMC-001 bytes are changed.
No physical Pre-A, spacetime, gravity, QFT, Yang--Mills, continuum, mass-gap or TOE conclusion follows.
